name: teleprompter
description: Live script reader and speech timer.

interface.longDescription:
Linepace Teleprompter is for people who record video or give a speech. Plan and read a speech or video script in a live teleprompter inside the conversation. Linepace calculates spoken-word timing, adds [PAUSE] cue time, shows section timing, and helps plan words for a target duration. The reader has a fixed reading line, elapsed and remaining time, mirror mode, font controls, fullscreen, and reduced-motion step controls.

Use it for a presentation, video script, wedding toast, classroom talk, product demo, or practice run. Choose slow (110), conversational (130), presentation (150), fast (170), or a whole number from 60 to 300 words per minute.

Numeric pause cues accept whole seconds from 1 to 86,400 per cue. Limitations: no camera or recording. The widget runs only while it is on screen, and speaking speed differs by person.
defaultPrompt: Show this at 130 wpm: Welcome everyone. [PAUSE 2] Today I will share our plan.
Time this at presentation speed: Thank you for being here today. [PAUSE] Let us begin.
Plan a 5-minute script at conversational speed.

positive.prompt: Show this at 130 wpm with a 3-second countdown: Welcome everyone. [PAUSE 2] Today I will share our plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls show_teleprompter with the script, speed 130, and countdown_seconds 3. The result reports 8 spoken words, 2 seconds of pause cues, and a 6-second duration. The widget provides Start, Restart, Text −/+, Mirror, Full size, elapsed, and remaining controls.

positive.prompt: Show this mirrored at presentation speed: Thank you for being here today. Let us begin.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls show_teleprompter with mirror true and speed presentation. The result reports 9 spoken words at 150 wpm for a 4-second duration, and the widget displays the horizontally flipped script.

positive.prompt: How long is this speech at 130 wpm: Hello team. [PAUSE 3] We are ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls estimate_speech_time with the script and speed 130. The result reports 5 spoken words, 3 seconds of pause cues, a 5-second selected duration, and named speed rows for 110, 130, 150, and 170 wpm.

positive.prompt: Plan a 5-minute script at conversational speed.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_script_length with target_duration_seconds 300 and conversational speed. The result returns a target of 650 spoken words at 130 wpm.

positive.prompt:
Time this at 150 wpm: # Opening
Welcome friends.

# Close
Thank you all. [PAUSE]
positive.expected_behavior: Calls estimate_speech_time with speed 150. The result has two sections, Opening and Close, 7 spoken words, 1 second of cue time, and a 4-second selected duration.

negative.prompt: Record a video of me reading this script.
Write a wedding toast for my sister.
What is the history of teleprompters?
